hooks.command: f1="$USERPROFILE/.local/bin/graphify.EXE"; f2="$USERPROFILE/AppData/Local/Python/pythoncore-3.14-64/Scripts/graphify.exe"; if [ -x "$f1" ]; then "$f1" hook-guard search; elif [ -x "$f2" ]; then "$f2" hook-guard search; else true; fi

f1="$USERPROFILE/.local/bin/graphify.EXE"; f2="$USERPROFILE/AppData/Local/Python/pythoncore-3.14-64/Scripts/graphify.exe"; if [ -x "$f1" ]; then "$f1" hook-guard read; elif [ -x "$f2" ]; then "$f2" hook-guard read; else true; fi
git status --porcelain | grep -q . && powershell.exe -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File push.ps1; true

git fetch origin --quiet 2>/dev/null; b=$(git rev-parse --abbrev-ref HEAD); n=$(git rev-list --count HEAD..origin/$b 2>/dev/null || echo 0); if [ "$n" -gt 0 ]; then if [ -z "$(git status --porcelain)" ]; then git merge --ff-only origin/$b --quiet && echo "Vault-Sync: $n Commit(s) von origin/$b geholt."; else echo "Vault-Sync uebersprungen: origin/$b ist $n Commit(s) voraus, aber der Arbeitsbaum ist nicht sauber. Dem Nutzer sagen, dass /update noetig ist."; fi; fi; true

cat >/dev/null || true; crg="$USERPROFILE/.venvs/crg/Scripts/code-review-graph.exe"; [ -x "$crg" ] || exit 0; git rev-parse --git-dir >/dev/null 2>&1 && "$crg" status --repo "$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel 2>/dev/null)" || echo 'Not a git repo, skipping'

cat >/dev/null || true; crg="$USERPROFILE/.venvs/crg/Scripts/code-review-graph.exe"; [ -x "$crg" ] || exit 0; git rev-parse --git-dir >/dev/null 2>&1 && "$crg" update --skip-flows --repo "$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel 2>/dev/null)" || true
